name: KPZ Growth
desc: A thin film growing in cross-section: vapour arrives along a beam and sticks to the first material it grazes, so tips capture the flux and shadow their neighbours, the front roughens into the self-affine Kardar-Parisi-Zhang interface, and the buried film keeps the record as tilted columns, overhangs and voids while the beam's glancing angle swings and chevrons them; the substrate scrolls away beneath forever, read as a greyscale cross-section SEM, deposition-time stratigraphy, an absorption radiograph, or a blueprint of the void network.

energy.doc: relief contrast and the latent glow at the growth front

scale.doc: magnification into the film cross-section - guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: deposition flux - how fast the film grows and scrolls (0.2 still grows)

density.doc: packing density: high = diffuse flux and a solid film, low = a collimated beam that shadows itself into porous columns

tilt.doc: how far the beam swings off normal - column tilt and chevron amplitude

grain.doc: detector noise plus the strata band frequency

hue.doc: hue of the film; the growth front takes its complement

x.doc: pan across the cross-section when magnified

y.doc: pan through the film depth when magnified

style.doc: aesthetic: greyscale cross-section SEM / deposition-time colour stratigraphy / absorption radiograph / blueprint of voids and the front profile

seed.doc: deterministic restart from a bare substrate
